items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Then he had -- kept Jesse Powell, who was a beginner, learner.

ctx.x: And because most of the guys he had in there were -- few were pure amateurs with the exception of Holmes and another alto player that had been -- I think he went blind or something. Then he had -- kept Jesse Powell, who was a beginner, learner. He didn't even know how to take a solo, couldn't play 12 bars without getting lost and all that sort of thing.
He had -- he didn't have any horns. They had some guys that could read, but they couldn't solo at all.
